# Droplet

Canonical: https://fuvji.github.io/droplet/
Source: https://github.com/fuvji/droplet
Version: 2.8.0
Platform: Windows 10/11 x64
Licence: proprietary, public source for inspection

Droplet is a small, local keyboard-and-mouse macro suite for Minecraft Java,
branded Minecraft Zero Macro. It is a native Rust overlay with no runtime
dependencies, no network calls, no telemetry, and no game-memory access. It
injects ordinary keyboard and mouse input through Win32 SendInput and remains
visible to screen capture.

## Current release

- Compact 624x408 graphite/white acrylic overlay with a transparent droplet mark.
- System > Color offers six accent presets plus Red, Green, and Blue sliders.
- Every trigger card switches between Hold (one-shot) and Toggle (latched repeat).
- Four-tab native UI preview uses a CSS crossfade of stills, not gameplay.
- Release 2.8.0 portable executable: 594,944 bytes.
- 19 release tests pass, including RGB parsing, trigger-mode latch coverage,
  and the allocation-free binding lookup used by the panel.
- Pre-indexed trigger routing; the release benchmark measured 0.45 ns for the
  routing lookup versus 202.39 ns for the old binding scan.
- Anchor normal path is 100 ms shorter than 2.5.0, with every step kept at or
  above the 50 ms Minecraft tick.
- Sprint pulses every 100 ms while physical W is held; it is the only repeating
  watcher and never holds the key between pulses.
- Anchor, Crystal, Mace, Shield, Potion, Pearl, Totem, Breach, Fast Use, Auto Use,
  W-Tap, and Hover Inventory are one-shot or bounded actions.
- No streamproof or capture-concealment mode, no process hiding, no scan
  evasion, no anti-cheat bypass, and no zero-latency claim.
